additional_info.subject: RE: 0390506 - ID0390506-DC/Si-D/GB-[MP / R0 170002820]  remotely check the signal strength of the OCPP modem CRM:02023000316
additional_info.body:
Hi Vaishnavy,
Thanks for looking into this for me – the problem at this site is that the mobile signal quality drops when a bus parks in front of the charger. We fitted external antennas to the modems last week, which I think has improved things a little.
OCPP was deliberately configured to be off, as we set the charger to “no authentication” so it could be used when the mobile signal drops out.
Could we have a quick call today to discuss?
Thanks,
Jason
